inputs.text: You know, SSANU just gave the federal government a one-month ultimatum to wrap up the renegotiation of that 2009 agreement with the non-teaching university unions, or face an indefinite nationwide strike. It came straight out of their 54th National Executive Council. But this is obviously another coordinated move by the hidden elites and institutions pulling the strings from behind the scenes. The endless delays and these strike threats are being engineered on purpose to whip up unrest, tear down public institutions like the universities, and push their secret agenda forward while the union and government both act out their scripted parts in the whole charade.
